payload.reason: The evidence indicates that different variants of ROUGE scores yield varying correlations with human judgments, particularly highlighting that ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 show stronger correlations in scientific summarization contexts.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in different correlation values with human judgments.
ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 are better correlated with manual judgments in scientific summarization.
Keyword-based reduction variants have high correlation with ROUGE scores.
